decision_conditions: The operations come within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, thereby not requiring planning permission.

This certificate provides confirmation that the development is lawful.  You should also check whether the development requires separate Building Regulation consent. Information is available on the Building Control webpages and the team is available between 9am and 10am Monday to Friday via 01708 432700.

Please note that this certificate is granted for the outbuilding proposed to be used for storage space. It must only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 60 Rush Green Road, Romford and not for any trade or business nor as living accommodation. Should business or living accommodation use be intended, an application for full planning permission must be applied for and permission granted before such use could occur. The use of outbuildings as living accommodation is not typically deemed acceptable therefore it is important the outbuilding is only used for the purposes as listed above.
This certificate relates solely to the outbuilding shown on plan and does not confirm the lawfulness of any other development not within the description set out on this decision notice.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the construction of a rear outbuilding comprising office, gym, and associated facilities, following demolition of the existing garage
